turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: Hey Maya. Good to hear your voice today. How are things going on your end?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey Wren. Pretty good, actually. A little surreal, honestly, because something totally unexpected popped up.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Well, you remember Corvid Labs, right? The company that dropped me after the hiring manager interview back in September?

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: Of course I do. What came up with them?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: So out of nowhere, a recruiter from Corvid Labs reached out about a new BDR team that's starting up in November.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: That is quite a twist after last month. How did it feel when you saw their email?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly, I stared at the screen for a minute to make sure I wasn't imagining it. I was pretty bummed after they passed on me, so it was a nice shock.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: Rejections always leave a mark, so that makes complete sense. Did they mention what the next steps look like?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: She just asked if I'd be open to hopping on a quick call this Friday to discuss the scope and see if the timing works.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: That sounds promising. Did you send a reply yet?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yep, I sent a note back about an hour ago saying I'd love to connect. I offered a couple of time slots.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: Good. You'll already know a bit about their product and team culture from last time. How are you feeling about the rest of your week?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Way lighter, to be honest. It's nice not feeling like everything is riding on just one or two conversations.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: Options definitely take some weight off your shoulders. Do you want to do any prep today, or just take in the good news?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I think I just want to soak it in today, maybe take a breather before getting back to interview prep tomorrow.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: A breather is well earned. What are you going to do with your afternoon?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm going to grab an iced coffee and take a nice walk in the park. Thanks for being excited with me, Wren.
